correctness.rationale: For r>=2 named coordinate equivalence relations on disjoint nonempty rectangles, a source rectangle is R_t-path connected, so the forth condition confines its image to one target rectangle. Preserving R_t for t!=u forces output coordinate u to depend only on input coordinate u. The back equality on each R_u class forces each coordinate map surjective; hence each source-to-target choice has weight q_ij=prod_u Sur(a_iu,a_ju). Weighted inclusion-exclusion over target supports J counts all maps with exact image J; idempotents must fix their image rectangles and therefore yield product_{i notin J}sum_{j in J}q_ij. An omitted minimal vector type can map only to the same type; selecting at least one representative of each minimal type suffices by a coordinatewise-surjective idempotent onto chosen dominated minima. This yields exact Pareto support criterion, identical supports for ordinary and idempotent maps and 2^(m-sum c_tau)prod_tau(2^c_tau-1) supports. Direct independent Stirling-weight inclusion/exclusion for shape [(1,2),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)] gave E coefficients 64,128,64,64 at algebra image sizes 16,64,256,1024 and I coefficients 16,6,4,1, exactly six supports, 320 maps, 27 idempotents. Finite instance corroborates general proof.
